name: @absolutejs/autoscaler
description: Horizontal-scaling policy substrate for the AbsoluteJS PaaS. createAutoscaler periodically evaluates pluggable signals (CPU, queue depth, latency, ...) against a declarative policy (min/max instances, scale-up/down thresholds, cooldowns) and drives a caller-supplied actuator (spawn / drain / terminate). Pure decision logic — cloud-specific actuators live in the control plane.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --sourcemap --target=bun && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test
scripts.release: bun run format && bun run check:package && bun publish
